description: Whole dashed strokes of a cubic from (0.5, 0.5) to (150, 150) whose control points are 1e20 or 1e30, each in its own 200x200 cell: more than SkDashPath's 1,000,000 dashes, so each is drawn undashed. Round-capped at width 4 the stroker finds the cubic in line (its maximum curvature solves to NaN, which SkTPin takes to 0) and draws a line to the end; as hairlines of width 1 and 0.5 Skia draws the cubic as 512 lines whose points are finite but past what tiny-skia's finiteness test takes
toleranceNote: The stroke goes through the ports of Skia's dasher and stroker and the hairlines through the port of Skia's hairline subdivision into tiny-skia's hairliner (Skia's), so what remains is rounding in blending and coverage. 8 leaves room for another Chrome build that rounds differently.
